description:
Discover relevant docs, code, and symbols in a known public target. Start here for unknown locations; read known symbols with selector instead. The target sets project/version scope; put other constraints in query and inspect warnings and sourceStatus. Use sufficient hits directly; otherwise replay a hit's complete read action or followUp, keeping its target, path, selector and bounds together. Use visible hits while indexing continues; call search_status only for a returned active action and searchRef when more results matter; never repeat search to poll. For suggestedSiteTargets, choose a site: target and retry explicitly; suggestions are not aliases. public_only filters code/symbols, not docs. Hosted docs are mutable; repository docs address snapshots.

Load the GitHits guide once per session first (`quick_start` or the `githits-mcp` skill).

allow_partial_results.description: Default true returns a serveable subset plus searchRef while other target/source pairs prepare. False requires all runnable pairs; refresh may still return complete interim hits with searchRef. Paginate with nextOffset.

format.description: Omit for text. Use json only when code consumes raw fields or text lacks a required field.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset (default 0). Continue pagination with the response's `nextOffset` when present.

public_only.description: Set true to restrict code and symbol results to public APIs. False is equivalent to omitting it; ignored for `source:"docs"`.

query.description: Focused missing behavior, API names, or exact text; omit redundant target/version keywords. Space-separate inline qualifiers, e.g. `createApplication kind:function category:callable path:lib/ intent:production lang:javascript`; no comma separators or trailing punctuation. Use `name:Router` for a name; qualifiers support query boolean syntax.

source.description: docs (guides/reference), code (source/tests), or symbol (APIs/entities); omit to auto-select.

target.description: One compact target: `npm:react@version`, `github:facebook/react@ref`, `launchpad:~owner/+git/repo@ref` (`lp:PROJECT` also accepted), or `site:react.dev`. Omit the suffix for the latest package version or repository default branch; a ref may be a branch, tag, or commit. `#` is for semantic fragments. For a docs page URL use read with that URL as target and no path; search docs with a package, repository, or site: target. Do not also pass `targets`.

targets.description: Up to 20 compact targets. Do not also pass `target`.

items.description: Compact package, repository, or site target; see target for forms.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Time to wait for results in ms. Default 30000, max 120000.

name: search
